title: Commutative algebra for deformation theory and patching, Part II: Kawasaki’s Cohen–Macaulay blowing-ups
summary: This continuation starts after the finite-module depth, support and Cohen–Macaulay theory of DeformationAndDerivedPatchingAlgebra R03.3. It develops ordered CM-secant and Huneke d-sequences, Kawasaki’s product-of-prefix-ideals calculus and blowing-ups of modules. The final target is a Cohen–Macaulay module blowing-up along the ideal determined by a CM-secant sequence, with the actual local-cohomology claims and dimension bound needed by the proof.
readme: Independently reviewed target-level plan covering all fifteen accepted route items in five layers, with typed suggestions, APIs and discriminating tests. K1 is closed; the other layers are planned with precise source/interface follow-ups. Suggested ordinary-duality consequences take concrete comparison data, and the vanishing claim exposes its outer-induction inputs. Generic local-cohomology, depth and CM remain in R03.3; normalized ordinary duality is requested from AS.1; existing StableReduction and AlgebraicVectorBundles geometry is reused, and generic module strict-transform gluing is requested from AdicCoefficientsAndComparisons L5.

stages.title: CM-secant sequences and annihilators
stages.description: Define the local-cohomology annihilator product and CM-secant sequences; compare with imported secant and CM conditions, including empty support. Prove Schenzel’s positive-power torsion bound, extension to parameters, reversed p-standard comparison, the normalized-duality annihilator identity, the CM-locus equality for equidimensional support and the general defect-set formula.

stages.title: Huneke d-sequences and power intersections
stages.description: Define d-sequences on arbitrary modules over commutative rings. Prove the corrected torsion/colon characterization with r_j rather than r_i, native weak-regular compatibility and the two separate Goto–Yamagishi intersection identities. Include zero, unit and order-sensitive tests.

stages.title: Kawasaki’s prefix-product sequence calculus
stages.description: Define products of successive prefix ideals and the unit/successor/prefix formulas. Prove Proposition 3.11 in its three separate clauses: reversed d-sequences after auxiliary secant quotients, power-torsion equality, and regularity lifting for the last auxiliary parameter. Prove robustness for a selected prefix under those quotients; establish prefixwise inheritance separately where the outer induction needs it.

stages.title: Rees modules and module blowing-ups
stages.description: Construct the graded Rees module with coefficient extensionality and functorial maps over the native Rees algebra, and sheafify it on the imported scheme blowup. Characterise induced sheaf maps on the actual chart image generators. Prove chart image and exceptional-kernel formulas, agreement with the imported module strict transform, two-ideal module comparison, support identification and the Rees/Proj dimension bound. Do not rebuild scheme blowups.

stages.title: Cohen–Macaulay blowing-ups
stages.description: Prove the regular-terminal-element reduction and dimension-zero depth induction, with Claims 3.14.5 and 3.14.6, explicit preceding-stage bounds for the original and power-quotient modules, and the actual chart relation r_bT−r_a. Derive the theorem first under the weaker prefix conditions and then for CM-secant sequences. Exhibit an explicit two-dimensional semigroup CM ring and depth-one maximal-ideal blowup chart.
